comparison.objective: Steer a laser onto a detector using two mirrors while blocking the beam during mirror movement; candidate tunes damper response.
comparison.physical_skill: Iterative fine mirror adjustment from optical feedback plus safety occlusion versus collar adjustment from mechanical impact feedback, setscrew locking and physical control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Beam reaches the detector after safe mirror movements; candidate requires two non-bottoming, stable carriage stops. Candidate lacks numeric rebound/overload/drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both use iterative feedback, but optical beam steering and safety blocking test a different physical skill and outcome from energy absorption.
